clusters.pick_reason: 2215 is the more complete fix: it makes the same trailing-slash normalization change but also updates shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper. members.title: fix(server): retire in-flight request state when the streamable HTTP transport closes
members.author: rxits
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same underlying bug: WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() does not settle a pending JSON-response-mode POST's response Promise, so handleRequest() hangs until the platform's own socket/HTTP timeout fires when the transport closes mid-request. #2600 additionally fixes a related correlation-map leak (_requestToStreamMapping never cleared in close(), letting a send() suspended in eventStore.storeEvent() resolve against a retired correlation) and settles parked JSON POSTs with a plain 404 'Session not found'. #2692 addresses only the pending-response settlement, but with more granular handling: it groups outstanding request ids by stream (needed for batched POSTs sharing one stream), reuses a real response for any id that already has one instead of overwriting it, and settles with a JSON-RPC -32000 'Connection closed' error rather than an HTTP 404. Both edit the same close() code path and would conflict on merge. (2 PRs)
